title: Upgrade your desktop: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS is now available
summary: Canonical announces the availability of Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, a long-term support release providing 5 years of security updates and support for desktop users seeking a stable and reliable operating system.
problem_solved: Provides users with a stable, long-supported desktop operating system with updated packages and extended security maintenance.
why_valuable: LTS releases offer predictability and stability for both individual users and enterprises who need a reliable OS with guaranteed support and security updates for 5 years.
